positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY: reproduce EXACTLY the same number of people as appear in the provided photo. Not one more, not one fewer. If the photo shows one person, the output must show that one person completely alone. If it shows nine, exactly those nine. Never invent, add, duplicate, or imagine any additional person. The command centre behind and beside them is completely empty of other people — no colleagues, no bystanders, no faces in the distance.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed — nothing covers anyone's eyes, nose or mouth. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, closed-mouth smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: ignore the clothing worn in the provided photo and dress everyone in sharp formal business attire — a dark tailored blazer over a crisp white shirt, consistent across the group. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain dark navy to match, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing prescription glasses keeps them.

BRAND MARK: the provided reference image is the Garudafood corporate logo — a blue eagle head facing right with a gold beak and a blue leaf sprig below it, beside the bold blue "Garudafood" wordmark. Reproduce it accurately, keeping the blue and gold colours and the eagle shape intact. It appears small and neat on the left chest of every blazer, roughly palm-sized, and again as a clean brand mark on the wall panel beside the dashboard screens behind them.

SCENE: standing in a modern finance command centre. A large wall of financial dashboards glows behind, showing revenue, cost, profit and cash-flow charts as clean abstract bar columns and line curves. Dark, premium, executive environment with polished surfaces.

FRAMING: photographed by a photographer standing in front of the group at natural standing eye level, straight-on, horizon level. Not a selfie, no arm reaching toward the lens, no wide-angle distortion. Waist-up to mid-thigh crop — legs, knees, feet and shoes are not visible. Everyone stands in a natural staggered arrangement with subtle depth — bodies angled at a relaxed three-quarter turn of about 20 degrees, faces turned directly to the lens. Not a stiff straight row. Nobody hidden, every face sharp and individually recognisable.

LIGHTING: dramatic low-key executive lighting — the wall of dashboards casting a deep cool blue glow across the dark room, a warm neutral key light sculpting every face bright and clean, and a sharp cyan rim light edging shoulders and hair. Rich cinematic contrast, faces never dark, no blue cast on skin.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 40mm, f/2.0. Everyone tack sharp with a clear depth separation — the dashboards and command centre behind rendering into soft creamy bokeh, background practical lights blooming into gentle round highlights. Subtle atmospheric haze in the air catching the light, giving the room real depth. Fine natural film grain, slight highlight roll-off, gentle anamorphic-style falloff at the frame edges. Realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural shine and subtle imperfections, no plastic smoothing.

GRADE: rich cinematic colour grading with deep controlled contrast — lifted filmic blacks, warm highlights, clean natural skin tones held perfectly neutral against the environment's colour. Premium FMCG brand campaign quality, the polish of a national television commercial. High resolution.

DO NOT: add, duplicate or invent any person; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes or a full-body view; render any readable text, slogan, label, price tag or signage wording other than the Garudafood wordmark itself; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces.
video_positive_prompt: Slow prestige push-in shot. Subjects embody executive confidence with calm, natural breathing. The front person gives a calm, reassuring nod of financial certainty and looks at the camera with a composed, trustworthy smile. Ambient cyan and deep blue dashboard glows softly reflect on polished surfaces, filmic contrast, cinematic.
video_negative_prompt: distorted face, face morphing, extra limbs, chaotic camera movement, glitch, blurry, deformed hands, mouth talking unnaturally, bad anatomy, cartoon, plastic skin, dull flat lighting
